title: Common problems
summary: What to try when the game crashes, looks wrong or will not join.

sections.heading: The game crashes
steps: If the game crashes on start, try Safe mode on Logs and help.
If that works, Find the crashing mod finds the extra mod that crashes it.
Click Send my logs on Logs and help. You see every file first, then you get a short code. Post only that code on Discord.
Click Open client logs on Logs and help to find the log files.

sections.heading: Graphics look wrong
steps: Close Bannerlord, open Settings and click Clear shader cache. It does not touch mods or saves.

sections.heading: The join does not start
steps: Do not click Connect while Bannerlord is open.
Import the host's mod list again and click Check mods.
Pick the same setup as the host.
